title: OpenPlanr User Story frontmatter (v1.0.0)
description: JSON Schema for the YAML frontmatter of a user story artifact. Accepts both planr-pipeline modes via a top-level `oneOf` over the parent reference: spec-driven user stories (US-NNN-{slug}.md under <SPEC_DIR>/stories/) carry `specId: "SPEC-NNN"` and live scoped to a parent SPEC; default-mode user stories (output/feats/feat-{slug}/us-N/us-N.md) carry `featureSlug: "<slug>"` and live scoped to a parent feature folder. Exactly one of the two parent-reference fields must be present per story; the other must be absent.

id.description: User Story identifier (e.g. US-001). Scoped to the parent SPEC (spec-driven) or parent feature (default mode).

specId.description: ID of the parent spec this story belongs to. Spec-driven mode only — must be absent in default mode.

featureSlug.description: Slug of the parent feature folder this story belongs to. Default mode only — must be absent in spec-driven mode.

slug.description: URL-safe lowercase slug used in the story file name.

schemaVersion.description: Pinned to the OpenPlanr Protocol reader version.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the story.

priority.description: Optional priority tier (inherits from parent spec when absent).

updated.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) bumped on every edit.

kanbanosId.description: Optional opaque entity id on the kanbanos hosted board, written back by the sync tool after a successful push (the linearId precedent from the OpenPlanr CLI Linear integration). Sync-tool-owned: humans and planning agents never author or edit it by hand. Absent until the artifact is first pushed. See ADR-012.

contentHash.description: Optional digest of the artifact content at the last successful board sync, written back by the sync tool alongside kanbanosId so drift between file and board is detectable. Same sha256:<hex> shape as operating-evidence-index-item@1.3.0. Sync-tool-owned: humans and planning agents never author or edit it by hand. See ADR-012.

oneOf.title: spec-driven story → requires specId, forbids featureSlug
default-mode story → requires featureSlug, forbids specId
